newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel - some HS sold, LS quiet.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel - some HS sold, LS quiet.

text.p: A couple of Russian high sulphur straight-run cargoes found homes on Tuesday, while low sulphur material stayed in the shop window.
Dealers said an E-4 was done at $129 cif NWE and a low water good quality M-100 was sold into the U.K. at around $126 cif amid speculation it may be used for bunkering.
Russian cargoes have been thinned by recent buying, but at least a couple were still available.
The low sulphur straight-run market moved higher to show crude's recent gains, but offers of $147 fob NWE found no takers.
